lustre/tests/sanity.sh.message: Done: -type is gone, so the directories reach the LMV fetch now. The old check did fail on the parent, though (exit 1 on 68094 in the lab): the files' own stat goes off Lustre too.

lustre/utils/liblustreapi_pfind.c.message: A walk that starts off Lustre already gets -EOPNOTSUPP for -B, on the parent and in stock lfs find: fp_lmd is calloc()ed, so STATX_BTIME is never set there. The parent only avoided it by using the previous object's btime. Making -B a non-match off Lustre would change what -B means, so I would keep that out of this patch.
